munit:test.name: instalment-follows-the-annuity-formula
munit:test.description: EMI = P r (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1) with r = annual rate / 1200, rounded to 2 decimals

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::scoring output application/json --- { a: emi(500000, 12, 36), b: emi(200000, 12, 24), c: emi(1000, 12, 12), d: emi(120000, 0, 12) }

munit:test.name: points-run-linearly-between-the-two-end-values
munit:test.description: Higher is better: 0 at the low end, 100 at the high end, linear between, held outside

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from modules::scoring output application/json --- { low: points(600, 600, 750), high: points(750, 600, 750), mid: points(675, 600, 750), over: points(900, 600, 750), under: points(500, 600, 750), third: points(665, 600, 750) }

munit:test.name: largest-affordable-amount-is-a-multiple-of-the-step
